headline: 3 arrested, including mastermind, for bKash businessman Motaleb's murder in Narayanganj
summary: Police in Narayanganj have arrested three individuals, including the alleged mastermind, in connection with the murder of bKash businessman Motaleb. This development brings significant progress to the ongoing investigation.
details: Police in Narayanganj have arrested three individuals, including the alleged mastermind, in connection with the murder of bKash businessman Motaleb. The arrests mark a significant development in the ongoing investigation into the crime.
The victim, Motaleb, was a bKash agent, whose murder prompted a police inquiry. Authorities have been working to identify and apprehend those responsible for his death.
During the operation, law enforcement officials recovered several items from the suspects. These include multiple mobile phones, cash, a tiffin carrier, and a bag, which are now part of the evidence.
The arrested individuals are currently in police custody. Further legal proceedings are underway as the investigation continues to uncover more details about the incident.
